security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Session, roles, sources and known limitations.
security.sessionSince: Session cookie valid 7 days; logout revokes it server-side.
security.roleOwner: OWNER — manages the business, sources, approvals and audit access.
security.roleAccountant: ACCOUNTANT — manages financial records and imports, reads reports.
security.roleViewer: VIEWER — read-only access to permitted resources.
security.eventsEmpty: No security events recorded in this window.
security.controlLogout: Log out — revokes this session on the server immediately.
security.controlPassword: Password change is not available in this environment (see limitations).
security.limitCsrf: Login, register and demo endpoints are CSRF-exempt (pre-auth); all authenticated mutations require the double-submit token.
security.limitEmail: Email verification and password reset are NOT implemented — no mail provider is connected.
security.limitRateLimit: Rate-limit and account-lockout stores are per-instance; multi-instance deployments need a shared store (Redis).
security.limitAudit: Audit hash-chain serialization is per-instance; multiple API instances require a database-level lock.
security.neverClaim: This page reports controls as implemented and their limits honestly — it is not a security guarantee.
